New in this build:
- MIDI round trip: BreakBoss MIDI recorded in your DAW plays BreakBoss back like an instrument (each pad on its own MIDI channel, the 808 pitched on channel 7), in ONE-SHOT and LOOP mode.
- Drum roll: pinch or trackpad-spread to zoom; SNAP gets finer as you zoom in. New 2-bar pattern length.
- Record pads MPC style: hold PLAY on the faceplate to arm recording (red ring), then finger-play the pads.
- SELECT tool note trimming, the IMPORT sound library on each channel, and FOLLOW DAW play/stop.

Please try recording BreakBoss into your DAW and playing it back, zooming the drum roll, and finger-recording on the pads.
